packageRules.description: Keep the sidecar base images on Python 3.14. The images install their locked packages as wheels only, and PyYAML 6.0.3 (needed by transformers and huggingface-hub) publishes wheels only up to cp314, so a python 3.15 base cannot build (#1147). Lift this rule once every locked package ships a cp315 wheel for linux/x86_64, PyYAML included.
